supporting_pages.title: Job creation and execution overview \_|\_ Batch \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Task scheduling When a job runs, its tasks are scheduled according to the scheduling policy ( schedulingPolicy ) field , which lets you specify one of the following options: As soon as possible ( AS SOON AS POSSIBLE ) (default): tasks run as soon as resources are available and can run in parallel.

If you have a workload with varying resource requirements, you can reduce costs and quota usage by separating the types of VMs used for low-demand operations (like data preparation) and compute-intensive operations (like data processing).
The job remains in your project's queue until it can be scheduled, which happens when the required resources are available and the jobs ahead of it have been assessed.
